description: This file defines the LoanCOBPartitioner class, which implements the Spring Batch Partitioner interface to partition loan data for batch processing of Coordinated Operations Batch (COB). It retrieves a set of loan partitions based on business logic, creates execution contexts for each partition, and manages job execution states.

classes.name: LoanCOBPartitioner
classes.description: Implements a partitioner for loan COB batch jobs, splitting the workload into partitions based on loan IDs and business logic, managing job execution states.

methods.name: partition
methods.description: Main entry point to create a map of partition names to execution contexts based on grid size.

methods.name: getPartitions
methods.description: Generates and retrieves partition data, creating execution contexts for each partition.

methods.name: getLoanCount
methods.description: Calculates total number of loans across all partitions.

methods.name: createNewPartition
methods.description: Creates an ExecutionContext object populated with partition-specific data.

methods.name: stopJobExecution
methods.description: Stops any running job execution instances of the COB job.
